## 3. Flagship Production Platforms
### Project 1: Agentic FacilityOps AI Platform
- Live URL: https://facilityops-platform.vercel.app/
- Source Code: https://github.com/krbipin/Agentic-FacilityOps-AI-Platform
- Architecture: Autonomous multi-agent building intelligence platform with Next.js 16 frontend, FastAPI microservice backend, PostgreSQL Neon database, and Groq LLM Facility Copilot.
- Agents: 8 autonomous modules (Energy, Maintenance, Occupancy, Security, Cost, Intelligence, Alerts, Executive Reporting).
- Telemetry: Live 1-minute streaming sensor telemetry with real-time recalculation of health metrics.
- Models: RandomForest risk scoring for equipment degradation and IsolationForest for real-time anomaly detection.

### Project 2: SwasthyaAI: Diabetes Risk Predictor
- Live URL: https://diabetes-predictor-muqth3gs8dfgsg9ea2wqz3.streamlit.app/
- Source Code: https://github.com/krbipin/diabetes-predictor
- Architecture: Public health diagnostic machine learning tool trained on 8 clinical features (pregnancies, glucose, blood pressure, skin thickness, insulin, BMI, pedigree function, age).
- Implementation: Standardized scaling pipeline with serialized (.sav) models running with <150ms inference on Streamlit.
